title: Benowitz placed in a mental health facility
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Benowitz placed in a mental health facility, about 1980s at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So they actually put him in a mental health facility for like a month or so

plain: Greg Bishop, a researcher and author, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that Paul Bennewitz, a man in Albuquerque, New Mexico who became convinced aliens were active near the local Air Force base, was put in a mental health facility for about a month in the 1980s. Bishop tells it as part of a story about how Bennewitz's beliefs about aliens took a heavy toll on him.
